title: Primavera
description: A modpack for friends! A kitchen-sink pack that's made for Create: Aeronautics and No Man's Land/Nature's Spirit.
body:
## Primavera is a modpack for friends!
It's fairly lightweight for a kitchen-sink. Very much in-line with Create: Aeronautics! Includes a lot of Create Add-ons (including Create: Aeronautics), Kaleidoscope: Cookery, and Nature's Spirit/No Man's Land. 

**8 Gb** is recommended for this pack! Good luck!

Included Mods:
